citations.name: habeas:coverage
citations.commentary:
This edge-only validation regression deliberately supplies no node
 contents. Its records assert selection dependencies only. Domain
 requires this callback, but reaching it would introduce an unwanted
 content read and fail this guard.

rationale:
No gap in the `habeas:coverage` citation on `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tests.rs#fn[agent_edge_tools_record_selections_without_validating_targets]/impl[GraphWithChangingEdges/Domain]/fn[node_content]`.

- **Applicability:** `node_content` is an explicit function with a body, so a function-level coverage exception applies.
- **Substantive reason:** The commentary is in fenced citation commentary. It says the test is edge-only and supplies no node contents. It says `Domain` requires this callback, and that executing it would be an unwanted content read that fails the guard.
- **Agreement with source:** The callback body is `panic!("edge inspection must not read node contents")`, so it is a deliberate guard. The test `agent_edge_tools_record_selections_without_validating_targets` asserts only `Dependency::OutgoingEdges` records, edge lookup counts, and edge tool results. It never reads node contents. The `Domain` impl for `GraphWithChangingEdges` does include `node_content` as a required method, as the commentary says.
- **Why zero execution is right:** Zero execution of this function is the intended outcome, because executing it would fail the test.
